orgName: UEFA Champions League 2027 final (Estadio Metropolitano, Madrid)
note: Nine-year stadium naming-rights deal (Riyadh Air Metropolitano, worth a reported EUR 250-300m) that brands the 2027 UCL final venue. Indirect: UEFA uses the non-commercial name 'Estadio Metropolitano' and clean-venue rules hide naming rights during matches. The same company is Atletico de Madrid's front-of-shirt sponsor.
